descriptionChirho: Qal stative/intransitive sense: to suffer the loss of one's children, to be deprived of offspring through death or calamity; the subject experiences bereavement.
Piel causative sense: to deprive someone of their children, to make childless through killing, judgment, or destruction; the subject actively causes another's bereavement.
Piel sense applied to pregnancy loss: to miscarry, to cast the young, to suffer or cause abortion; used of women or animals losing unborn offspring, distinct from post-birth bereavement.
Hifil causative sense: to cause to miscarry or cast the fruit of the womb; the subject (typically a curse, condition, or divine judgment) induces pregnancy loss in another.
